title: Legacy CPAT bug fixes: engineer power model
others: the engineer road-transport plan and the other-mitigation plan
policy: Policy block: copy the fixed baseline row and Paste Special → Formulas onto the policy row given (+6,331 rows for every Mitigation row in this document except L108; rows above 2173 are shared and have no policy copy). L108 (rows 7897-7903) sits where the policy block is +6,317 but reads power rows at +6,331, so its policy formulas are spelled out; the CoC and MTInputs cells (L56, L84, L107) have no policy copy.
extra: Expected effects: L1-L12 from the repo's Python copy of the legacy power model (power_model_ref_v3_8.py, which matches the cached legacy rows to 1e-13; price feedback to other sectors excluded); L52-L111 from the v0.5.4 register and the prototype (excel_ai/mitigation/LegacyBugFixes_v5_4.md, power_model_ref_v5_4.py mvp_data() and engine()) and the cached Egypt values of the file. Nothing was recalculated in Excel.

Bug IDs L52-L111 are those of the v0.5.4 register (excel_ai/mitigation/issues_register_v5_4.py). Their current formulas were decoded from the .xlsb itself (tools/dec.py) and checked against the LibreOffice conversion; every fill range was checked cell by cell (one R1C1 pattern) and every policy row against its baseline row.
P2981:T2985 (L52) are single-cell array formulas in the file; a normal entry of the new formula gives the same result.
summary: 27 bugs of the engineer power model and of its data, price and revenue blocks, 57 cell entries: L1-L12 (sections D6, H-L) and, from the v0.5.4 register, L52-L56, L67, L83, L84, L88, L95 and L107-L111. Every fix gives the cells to edit; L107 also needs a new MTInputs input row and defined name (see its note). In the shipped Egypt runs the fixes that change results are L1, L2, L3, L5, L6 (the ten result-changing fixes L1-L10 together: 2040 generation +12.6% baseline, +9.2% carbon tax) and, of the new ones, L53 (actual capacity factors), L52 (solar fixed O&M), L54 (no hydro investment before 2030) and L67 (capacity bought for next year's demand); the other new fixes act only with settings those runs do not use.
order: Suggested order: the data step first (L53, L52, L55, L54), then L67, then demand (L1, L3, L2) and L5, L6; then the price and revenue items (L83, L84, L108, L110, L111) and L88; then the other Low items. L2 and L95 edit the same four cells (independent substitutions, either order); L107 needs its MTInputs row and name before E2736 is changed.
